# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolboy  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony has a dark, sullen face with black eyes. He is a small boy with a cute look when not looking sullen.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)_

## Personality

Anthony is an independent, mischievous child with a sullen, scornful demeanor. He holds a firm prejudice that female teachers are useless compared to men. Despite his stubbornness, he shows a sense of fairness and respects authority when dealt with firmly.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_

## History

Anthony Pye was taken in as an orphan by his aunt, Mrs. George Pye, and began attending Avonlea school under Anne Shirley. From his arrival, he harbored a prejudice against female teachers and expressed hostilty and contempt toward Anne. He engaged in various pranks at school, including pouring water down a classmate's neck and placing a live mouse in Anne's desk. After Anne lost her temper and whipped him with a pointer for the mouse prank, Anthony's bravado broke, but the punishment unexpectedly earned Anne his respect. Following the incident, he began helping her carry her books to school and acknowledged that her discipline was as effective as a man's. When Anne eventually resigned as teacher, Anthony fought two pitched battles with other schoolboys to release his feelings.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P30](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0030), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c12 P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052), [v2 c26 P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_
